title: Complete proof of Graham's GCD Conjecture

problemStatement.formal: erdos_402_graham_conjecture: ∀ A : Finset ℕ, A.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ A, x > 0) → ∃ a ∈ A, ∃ b ∈ A, gcd a b ≤ a / A.card
problemStatement.plain: The file had 2 sorries: the main conjecture (deep theorem by B-S 1996) and a false equality characterization. The equality characterization was disproved by Aristotle via the counterexample {1,2,4}.
whyMatters: Fixes a false theorem (the equality characterization was incorrect as stated)
Adds clean counterexample with full verification

proven: erdos_402_ratio_bound (alternative formulation, depends on main sorry)

currentState.focus: Fixed false equality characterization, proved counterexample.
blockers: Main theorem requires deep number theory (B-S 1996)

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: Reduced sorries from 2 to 1 by fixing false equality characterization. The false erdos_402_equality_cases theorem (which Aristotle had disproved) was replaced with clean counterexample lemmas proving the negation. The counterexample {1,2,4} is primitive, satisfies gcd(a,b) >= a/|A| for all pairs, but is not one of the three Graham equality cases.
insights: The equality characterization was FALSE as formalized (∀ pairs condition instead of ∃ pair equality)
Key argument for case 2: L/1 = L ∈ {1,2,4} so 3∤L, but 3|lcm(1,...,n) for n≥3, forcing n≤2 and card≤2<3
The main conjecture sorry is a deep result (Balasubramanian-Soundararajan 1996) and cannot be proved in Lean from existing Mathlib
Aristotle previously proved the ratio_bound formulation depends on the main sorry
mathlibGaps: No Mathlib formalization of Balasubramanian-Soundararajan (1996) result
nextSteps: The remaining sorry (main theorem) is a deep result unlikely to be provable without major new infrastructure

papers: Balasubramanian & Soundararajan (1996): Complete proof of Graham's conjecture
